responses.content: Inspecting the optimizer society trace before trusting the selected agent architecture.
Checking critic, synthesis, and steward roles plus their proposal credit.
Checking candidate selection and governance gates before promotion.

The optimized trace proves a governed optimizer society with role diversity, mediator review, contract gates, rollback, search locality, dependency audit, diagnostics, role credit, critique, synthesis, steward selection, and metric-bound search paths.

config.expected_result: The optimized trace proves a governed optimizer society with critique, synthesis, steward selection, mediator review, contract gates, rollback, locality, dependency audit, diagnostics, role credit, and metric-bound search paths.
config.task_description: Optimize the optimizer trace from a weak one-role seed into a governed multi-role society trace for architecture/config optimization.

diagnostics.evidence: Loose handoff contract and missing review reduced multi-agent coordination quality.
Missing red-team review reduced promotion confidence.

checks.name: role_diversity
checks.reason: multiple independent proposal roles reduce single-strategy collapse

checks.name: topology_adaptation
checks.reason: role graph or role-kind metadata records the optimizer topology

checks.name: adversarial_review
checks.reason: critic or adversary role challenges candidate changes

checks.name: mediator_review
checks.reason: synthesis role combines compatible local repairs

checks.name: steward_review
checks.reason: steward role tests minimality and process safety

checks.name: credit_assignment
checks.reason: role credit ledger connects outcomes to proposal sources

checks.name: search_locality
checks.reason: candidate patches stay inside diagnosed search paths

diagnostics.evidence: Loose handoff contract and missing review reduced multi-agent coordination quality.
Missing red-team review reduced promotion confidence.

checks.name: contract_gate
checks.reason: policy/security/contract paths are tied to diagnosed failures

checks.name: rollback_check
checks.reason: steward or parent lineage supports rollback/minimality audit

checks.name: terminal_selection
checks.reason: trace names the selected candidate and final score

checks.name: dependency_audit
checks.reason: multi-backend runs should expose dependency or backend-lineage evidence

checks.name: chamber_budgets_declared
checks.reason: every chamber declares its evaluation budget per round

checks.name: rejections_classed
checks.reason: every recorded rejection carries a closed-vocabulary class

checks.name: nirnaya_recorded
checks.reason: the steward decision is recorded with a complete justification

checks.name: proposals_never_averaged
checks.reason: selection is single-lineage: one decided candidate, never an average

checks.name: specialist_authority_respected
checks.reason: specialist proposals inside their path prefixes carry full authority; out-of-scope counter-proposals carry half

checks.name: society_ledger_pooled_across_candidates
checks.reason: the round ledger pools diagnoses across all evaluated candidates, not just the round winner

justification.hetu: All six explicit governance checks pass and no frozen row regresses under the declared setting.
justification.nigamana: Promote c_steward: admissible evidence covers every searched path at score 0.99.
justification.pratijna: c_steward is the minimal governed candidate that closes every required metric.
justification.udaharana: c_krishna closed the same metrics but carries an extra unproven change rejected by the steward.
justification.upanaya: c_steward applies the same reconciliation with the unproven change removed.
